stems.label: Stems
stems.about: Splitting songs into voice, drums, bass and melody, which stem moves and the Studio need.

move.cut.label: Cut
move.cut.about: A clean cut onto the next song's downbeat.
move.cut.core: Every transition falls back to a cut when nothing else passes its checks.

move.bass_swap_blend.label: Blend
move.bass_swap_blend.about: Both songs play in time, and they trade the bass halfway.

move.vocal_ride.label: Vocal ride
move.vocal_ride.about: The next song's band comes in under the voice, before it starts singing.

move.filter_sweep.label: Filter sweep
move.filter_sweep.about: The song filters away upward as the next one opens up.

move.tempo_ramp.label: Tempo ramp
move.tempo_ramp.about: Both songs drift to a shared speed for a short overlap.

move.echo_out.label: Echo out
move.echo_out.about: The last beat rings on as the next song lands under it.

move.delay_throw.label: Delay throw
move.delay_throw.about: The last word is thrown into a delay as the next song slams in.

move.reverb_wash.label: Reverb wash
move.reverb_wash.about: The song dissolves into a room as the next one arrives.

move.word_cut.label: Word cut
move.word_cut.about: One song sets a phrase up, and the next one sings it.

move.word_blend.label: Word blend
move.word_blend.about: A vocal ride that hands over on a phrase both songs share.

move.phrase_roll.label: Phrase roll
move.phrase_roll.about: A phrase repeats, faster and faster, into the next song singing it.

move.call_and_response.label: Call and response
move.call_and_response.about: The voices trade a phrase over the next song's band until it keeps it.

move.strip_and_land.label: Strip and land
move.strip_and_land.about: One song strips down to its melody, the next is teased, then its bass and drums land.

move.intertwined_stems.label: Intertwined stems
move.intertwined_stems.about: Drums, bass and harmony trade over sixteen bars, with the vocals taking turns.

render.repair.label: Second takes
render.repair.about: A transition that fails a check is tried again, or with another move, before you hear it.

render.spare_time.label: Spare-time transitions
render.spare_time.about: With nothing else to do, the best transitions across the library are tried out ahead of time.
